systemOverview.executiveSummary: Squire is a kept-alive Claude Code session on the Squire owner's Mac, set up by an installer and looked after by launchd agents. Core (Squire's own code and rules) comes only from releases signed by Stravica and is replaced whole; the Squire owner's folder holds everything personal and is never touched by an update.
systemOverview.systemPurpose: Give a Squire owner who is not technical a safe, always-on AI personal assistant on their own Mac and their own Claude plan.
systemOverview.architecturalApproach: Python and Swift, run by launchd agents; Node is used only for the development tool and never ships. Core and the Squire owner's folder are kept apart: core is replaced whole by a signed release and rolled back if its health check fails, and the Squire owner's folder is read at named points, where an overlay may change core behaviour except the safety rules. The safety rules (approval per item, the Rule of Two, nothing destructive and no install without a yes, secrets in the Mac's Keychain) are enforced by core's hooks. Pages are served on the Mac only. Support tickets carry allow-listed diagnostics to an intake on the product site; no shared key ships in any install.

A19. Safety, always on
